credibility.line: None of these promises can be checked against reported numbers yet — no score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed continuous margin expansion; reported EBIT% rose from 10.2% in Dec 2024 to 14.8% in Sep 2026.
Management claimed steady top-line execution; YoY revenue growth accelerated from 1.4% in Dec 2024 to 15.6% in Sep 2026.
Management emphasized strong cash flow; reported 5-year operating cash conversion stands at 133% of PAT.

bull: EBIT margin expanded to 14.8% in Sep 2026, approaching the 15% target for FY27.
Quarterly revenue grew 15.6% YoY in Sep 2026 to reach ₹16,180 crore.
Conservatively leveraged balance sheet with low D/E of 0.07 and robust cash conversion.
bear: Current ROCE of 23.1% remains well short of the 30% target promised for next year.
Analysts flagged concerns over AI pricing deflation and client decision delays following Anthropic Claude releases.
Analysts pressed on gross margin peaks, labor costs, and competitive pricing pressures.
watch: EBIT margin reaching the 15% target in H2 FY27.
Introduction of AI revenue reporting in H2 FY27.
